links.outcome: Whether case-level uncertainty score identifies poor segmentations (Dice <0.60) for triage
links.effect: U_clot AUC 0.89 for poor segmentation; threshold 0.323 gave 90% sensitivity, 96% NPV; 60% auto-accepted; volume-category agreement improved from 66% (κ=0.49) to 83% (κ=0.69).
links.quote: As a univariate predictor of poor segmentation, U_clot achieved an AUC of 0.89; the optimal threshold (0.323) yielded 90% sensitivity and 96% negative predictive value, allowing 60% of cases to be accepted automatically while improving volume-category agreement from 66% (κ=0.49) to 83% (κ=0.69).

links.effect: U_clot strongly inversely associated with Dice (ρ=−0.70 overall) and informative within all phenotype subgroups.
